statement: {M} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f x = ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, f x + f n
name: Finset.sum_range_succ
content:
Given a function `f : ℕ → ℝ` and a natural number `N`, `sum_range_succ f n` says that:
`∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), f n = ∑ n ∈ range N, f n + f N`.
